**1. Global Risk Regime?**

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading strongly: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +7.16%) ↑ rising; Technology also firm: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +2.85%) ↑ rising. Financials show a CORRECTION: XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +3.10%); style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US steady: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +2.75%) ABOVE TREND; Emerging markets modestly positive: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +1.20%) ↑ rising. China uneven: FXI CORRECTION (1W: -2.36% | 1M: +4.32%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation intact: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.81% | 1M: +2.33%) ↑ rising and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +2.78%) ABOVE TREND. Crypto cooling as IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.31% | 1M: -1.89%) ↓ falling.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leadership: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +8.81%) ↑ rising and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +11.08%) ↑ rising. Industrial metals mixed with CPER CORRECTION (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +3.84%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy broad-based: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +7.16%) ↑ rising and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.69% | 1M: +7.25%) ↑ rising. Natural gas in RECOVERY: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -3.04%) ↑ rising.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: SPY ABOVE TREND and XLK ABOVE TREND provide equity confirmation; GLD/SLV strength supports risk-on tilt in commodities. DIVERGENCE: multiple CORRECTION flags (XLF, FXI, CPER, XLI) represent MINOR divergence — not enough to flip the neutral regime.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective risk exposure to Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +7.16%)) and Metals (GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +8.81%); SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +11.08%)) while reducing exposure to uneven Financials (XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +3.10%)) and monitoring China (FXI CORRECTION).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +7.16%) — watch continuation on oil strength. BEARISH: XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +3.10%) — watch for follow-through weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +8.81%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +11.08%) — monitor safe-haven flows. BEARISH: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +3.84%) — watch for industrial demand fatigue.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 — VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.17% | 1M: -9.58%) ↓ falling marks complacency threshold. HYG/LQD ~0.80 — HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.40%) vs LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.58% | 1M: -0.59%) to monitor credit. XLK/XLF pivot near current spread — XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +2.85%) vs XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +3.10%).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, with broad sector participation but offsetting risk signals. Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +7.16%)) and precious metals (GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +8.81%); SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +11.08%)) showing relative strength, while CORRECTIONs in XLF (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +3.10%) and FXI (1W: -2.36% | 1M: +4.32%) are the key divergences to monitor.
